routing_readout: The 270-router selected-line layer scales the address space far beyond W33 while retaining diameter 3 and exact 15-vertex/15-edge connectivity; the 135-router point layer gives diameter 3 with connectivity 12. Both are shorter and more highly connected than the 160-flag Levi line graph, but W33 itself remains the strongest compact mixer at only 40 addresses.
falsifier_boundary: This is an exact unweighted graph-routing comparison. It does not include optical loss, switch latency, detector error, weighted coupler cost, fabrication constraints, or fault-tolerance thresholds; any hardware claim must be tested after those weights are supplied.
correction: This run also caught and corrected the Pass-4589 selected-line spectral multiplicity: eigenvalue -3 has multiplicity 150, not 165, so the spectrum sums to 270.
